Great app, most in depth. I mainly got this app as a companion to my Big Book of Tarot to use as a guide to help me interpret the cards and learn their meanings. This app out of all the ones I’ve tried has the most in depth explanations and I appreciate that. I got my 1st year 50% off which was $15 the whole year. Great price!

Be careful with this app, it’s a scam.. I subscribed to the free trial, tested the app, and canceled it, but I was still charged anyway. Apple did not refund the money.

Really Good App Except. This app is really good for learning Tarot and I have the widget on my main screen to learn about different cards. It’s really good for a new person buuuttt they didn’t use to have the reversed potion behind a pay wall. I don’t mind paywalls, I know everyone is trying to make money, but with all the complicated spreads behind a paywall and now the reversed position of the cards it’s becoming tedious when I’m doing notes on pulls. Because now I’m pulling information off of other websites that might not be the same as this app and it’s just all a mess. 

All and all it’s really good on the go but I will always rather use my physical cards at home.

Daily tarot. I’ve been using this app to teach me tarot. It’s a great little app. I mostly just study one card a day as I’m so busy with life and don’t want to overwhelm myself. The widget of a random card everyday is my absolute favorite. And I can study in the app. Perfect. I may upgrade one day

Misleading but great. The app itself is great and very insightful. I love how is set up, it includes AI insight and reversed meanings. The problem is, when I paid for the year subscription it said I'd have full access, but for the AI interpretation you have to pay separately besides one free interpretation a day. This is very misleading. I thought a year purchase to "full access subscription" would unlock everything in the app. Honestly, I wouldn't have paid for it if I knew otherwise.

Subscription user, pretty good companion to my real life decks.. I don’t do computer generated readings, but it does have several different kinds you can try. Might be a good way to study how these readings work and how things interact. Think of those as simulations, if you relate it to your life just think of it as a way to learn the meanings of the cards. I use this for the journal and the card definitions. I do a lot of one card readings and as a beginner this is a pretty good and effective reference and record keeping system. 
TLDR: Does what it says it does. Use with good judgement. I am genuinely grateful for this app, thank you creators. Good app.

Quiz answers often inaccurate. Interface is easy to use. Information is concise and helpful. The biggest issue, which causes giant hurdles in learning, is that the quiz answers are often marked wrong incorrectly. You may choose the correct answer but the app will mark it as wrong. When checking the answers at the end to cross reference, you will see that your answer matches the correct answer, but the app was incorrect. It’s incredibly frustrating and hinders the learning process. For this reason alone, I will likely cancel my subscription before the free trial runs out.

Fantastic Resource. This is a fantastic resource chock full of good stuff without any of the over-the-top nonsense of the other apps. I recommend this more than any book on the topic for those just getting started. What's available for free is everything one could need to get started and learn all of the cards, how to read for themselves and others, along with extra goodies for those who want to dive in more deeply. Nothing too woo-woo and no crystal balls here. The card meanings are rich and nuanced, the learning materials lay a great foundation (especially "How to Formulate Effective Tarot Questions"), and the quizzes are perfect for reinforcing the key themes of each card (Especially "Guess the Meaning"). And then everything can be put into practice with a card reading, with a built in journal to boot. It's all great and I highly recommend.

My only request is for a lifetime/one-time purchase option, as that is my general preference. (And just because I love this app so much, maybe also an Apple Watch companion app to do a one card pull/card of the day on the go as I feel like this dev would do it better than what's currently available in the App Store). Thank you for putting this app together!

Reverse cards = turning your phone upside down. I bought this just for learning, but the single quiz feature is really limited. You get to choose from 3 cards so it’s very easy to tell which the question refers to. Also the cards can appear in reverse form, which many practitioners never use and you’re not able to change the feature so they are upright. Learning from reversed positions is not only less intuitive but you can’t see the pictures on the card without physically turning the phone around. Great idea, needs more development from real users.

For Beginners, Moderate and Advanced!. The app is very to the book and I encourage all beginners to start with this very well versed interpretation of the individual cards and not to mention the diverse spreads. The name speaks for itself, “Learning Tarot”. I have been doing tarot for a little while now. However, I make it an extra point and effort to always refresh the basics every year at least. It is all too easy for an advanced reader to becoming very invested to a tunnel vision perspective of whatever few singular particular cards that we go throughout our lives and can at times become vulnerable. To instinctively becoming biased to the same interpretation reflecting in our own lives at various periods of our cycle. So, that being said, the app is well versed and to the book. I encourage even advanced fellow tarot readers to constantly refresh your energy. To freshen up on the basics is the healthiest way to overcome that bias vulnerability (depending where you are in your cycle), to not only refresh your energy healthily, but to grow from and move forward in your own current lessons. So we can give to others, with as little energy of our own diluting the reading (impossible to manage fully if the person being read is the same age, sex or situation). This app is a great app to do that for the new and the old. I hope this compliment meets the author of this app well and gives you even more fulfillment than just teaching the basics. There looks like some very well asserted lessons for beginners as well as moderate readers. I strongly encourage them to start here. I only needed a convenient refresher for myself so I did not purchase it personally. However, I know this is all real good stuff for moderate readers as well and moderate readers are even more susceptible to not clearing their own energy completely. I tip my hat to the author or “s” for their time invested. 
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Five Brightly shining review stars not only for beginners. For moderate readers to grow properly with such succinct roots. I thank you kindly on behalf of the advanced readers for the very apt refresher reminder. Healthy lessons for all! I am “Grateful”!
